newsitem.title: USA: Abducted Michigan schoolgirls seen in Florida - FBI.
newsitem.headline: Abducted Michigan schoolgirls seen in Florida - FBI.

text.p: Two young sisters who disappeared on Friday after stepping off a school bus were spotted in Florida over the weekend with the three men suspected of kidnapping them, the FBI said on Monday.

Teresa Hainer, 9, and Jessica Hainer, 6, of Galesburg, Mich., have been the subject of a nationwide search by law enforcement officers since they got into a station wagon with three men after school on Friday.
FBI Special Agent Thomas Bailey said an off-duty police officer spotted the girls, the car and the kidnapping suspects at a car wash in Gainesville, Fla., at about noon on Sunday.
"He recognised them from the news reports," Bailey said. "We feel very confident that we have a sighting."

Arrest warrants were issued on Saturday for three people who police believe to be familiar with the girls and their father, Jessie Hainer, who was separated from the girls' mother and with whom they lived.

The federal warrants charge Ronald Stafford, 21, his brother Lee Stafford, 17, and Ricky Geer, 19, with kidnapping. All are believed to live in the Galesburg area, which is about 10 miles east of Kalamazoo, Mich.
"The girls know them and they know the girls," Bailey said.

He added that when they were spotted on Sunday, the girls appeared "disheveled" but otherwise unharmed, and were wearing brown, baggy clothing that was different from the clothes they were last seen wearing.

Teresa and Jessica were supposed to go to a babysitter's home when they were dropped off in a Galesburg trailer park, but got into a cream-coloured 1988 Pontiac 6000 station wagon with wood-grain side panels and Michigan license plate number 1AX J93.
Bailey said law enforcement agencies were searching intensely in the Southeast, but were not limiting the effort to that region.

"One of our big concerns is that Gainesville is on the I-75 corridor," he said. "They were spotted at noon (Sunday), and that's more than 24 hours ago. They could be quite a long distance from there."
FBI officials also appealed to citizens band radio operators to help in the search. They believe Ronald Stafford has a CB radio in the car and transmits under the handle name "Cookie Monster."
The FBI set up a telephone hotline number of 888-324-4969 for anyone with information on the girls' wherabouts.
